parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The number of plans to purchase.

parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Set this parameter to true when you directly call this operation.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
- true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
- false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
- PREPAY: subscription.
- POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.

Set this parameter to PREPAY when you directly call this operation.

parameters.name: Coverage
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
- domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
- global: global.
- overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The purchase period, in months. This parameter is required when you directly call this operation.

parameters.name: PlanCode
parameters.description:
The plan code.

China site

- Free Edition: entranceplan
- Basic: basicplan
- Standard: standardplan
- Advanced: advancedplan

International site

- Entrance: entranceplan
- Pro: standardplan
- Premium: advancedpla

parameters.name: PlanName
parameters.description:
The plan name.

China site

- Free Edition: entranceplan
- Basic: basic
- Standard: medium
- Advanced: high

International site

- Entrance: entranceplan_intl
- Pro: basicplan_intl
- Premium: vipplan_intl

Note: For Enterprise Edition plans, the plan name is provided after backend configuration.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The site access type. Valid values:
- NS: NS access.
- CNAME: CNAME access.
